Chilling IRGC broadcast: after USS Lincoln drone scare, Iran threatens strike on 5 UAE civilian hubs
videos
Published on Feb 05, 2026 10:07 am IST
Share Via
Copy Link
An explosive warning from an Iranian insider has raised alarms across the Gulf, with a figure linked to the I.R.G.C. threatening that five major economic and technology hubs in Dubai could be targeted if the United States attacks Iran. Speaking on the IRGC-affiliated Ofogh TV, analyst Mostafa Khoshcheshm explicitly named civilian zones—including Dubai Airport Free Zone, DIFC, Dubai Internet City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, and Jebel Ali Free Zone—signaling a dramatic escalation that puts America’s closest Arab partner in the crosshairs. Fears of a wider Middle East war are surging as energy-critical shipping through the Strait of Hormuz hangs in the balance. The crisis deepens just days before U.S.–Iran nuclear talks in Oman, already shaken by a drone shoot-down near USS Abraham Lincoln and IRGC harassment of a commercial tanker.
